# Which DAT files hold a zone's building interiors.
#
# A city zone's own DAT is only its shell. These files are the insides of
# its buildings, and their placements are already in zone coordinates, so
# they need loading and nothing else.
#
# Generated by tools/subrooms.py; see docs/wiki/Object-Mapping.md for how
# the mapping is worked out and which entries are inferred.
#
# <zone dat>: <interior dat> ...
